entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集反复出现的通用概念：工程师每人同时跑 5-18 个智能体做长时程任务；AI 实验室要靠推出 Agents 把买家从工程师变成 CTO/CEO；不会编排智能体的工程师「不值得雇」。

evidence.quote: And having an AI agent is like having an AI coworker.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: What did you learn in that discovery process around agent orchestration internally?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: You do the same thing when you're interfacing with the agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: You want the agent to take the path of least resistance, not the path of most resistance.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And so I think about moments earlier in the year when my brother Tyler would literally have an alarm to wake up at three in the morning because he needed to check what the agent was doing at three in the morning and then you wake up, make sure it's good, go back to sleep.

evidence.quote: You want to babysit your agent basically every three hours and the beautiful thing now is you can go work out and the agent will tell you the answer and then you like voice note back with Speechify what you wanted to do next and like that'll happen.

entities.name: 开源模型 (open source model)
entities.how_described: 嘉宾提到的省钱路径：不付 Anthropic 的品牌模型 token 费，而是用自己的硬件跑开源模型，每 token 成本降到一分钱的零头的零头。

evidence.quote: Or you could run an open source model, and instead of running it on a Spot instance from Azure or anyone else, you run it on your own hardware, and then you're paying a fraction of a fraction of a cent per token.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: AI 实验室 (AI lab)
entities.how_described: 嘉宾反思错过 B2B 时提出的核心认知：AI 实验室的意义在于持续创新，第一个产品只是楔子——先让用户用上、免费也行，然后再卖别的东西。

evidence.quote: What I didn't understand is that the point of an AI lab like Speechify, or like Eleven Labs, is to continuously innovate.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 循环 (loop)
entities.how_described: 与 AI 协作的心法（引 Claude Code 发明者 Boris）：定目标、定度量，让智能体对着目标一遍又一遍迭代，而不是无目的烧 token。

evidence.quote: And ideally, you need users that use you a lot, and a lot of them, to have a feedback loop of whether the stuff is good or not.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: So what you want to build, and Boris, who's the inventor of Claude Code, talks about this all the time, it's all about the loop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
